In his quest to locate the mythical Monkey City and its hidden treasures, the covetous Captain Boone (Cary Elwes) will let nothing stand in his way, including Kitty (Lena Headey), the woman he once claimed to love.
With help from his loyal friends, including Baloo the bear, Mowgli (Jason Scott Lee) impresses his friend Kitty (Lena Headey) with whom he is reunited after many years of living in the jungle.
Protected by Bagheera, a blank panther, young Mowgli (Sean Naegeli) grows up without the influence of civilization and with a sense of values far different than any other human being.
